audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], spikes[0] and early all say Pantheon's passive blocks Vayne's autos.
audit.why: Mortal Will is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — there is no auto-attack block in the current kit. The real damage-denial tool is Aegis Assault (E), a 22/21/20/19/18s channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front. A player told his autos are blocked will stop attacking at exactly the wrong moment.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers his next spell; Aegis Assault is what blocks damage, and only from the front, only during the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Condemn cancelling Aegis Assault — appears nowhere.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is flagged channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it') and Condemn is hard CC on a 20s rank-1 cooldown against the E's 22s. Cancelling it wastes his entire defensive layer. Shield Vault is also a 600-range dash that Condemn denies, and it opens with an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the cue to step out, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Condemn cancels the Aegis Assault channel; Shield Vault dashes 600 on 13s at rank 1 and opens with an auto reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) sits with Pantheon in both layers while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vayne finally out-scales him there.
audit.why: The packet's own defect note flags the chart against a 52.07% Vayne win rate, and the audited Pantheon side moved this row to Vayne. Every piece of prose on the page already agrees.
audit.corrected: Row 6 to Vayne in both layers as a matched pair.

audit.why: Four spikes present, staged Lvl 3-5 / Lvl 6 / 1st item / Late, and the shape — his flat burst leading until Vayne's items outrun it — matches the chart once row 6 is fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block names no numbers.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22 down to 18s, Comet Spear 11 down to 8s at 575, Grand Starfall 180/165/150s from 5500. Grand Starfall's cooldown in particular means his level 6 threat is once every three minutes, not constant.

edits.after: Pantheon crushes the early lane — Comet Spear out-pokes your autos from 575, Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, and a level-3 Shield Vault all-in nearly kills you.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His point-click engage stun. Condemn after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shield Vault: 13s at rank 1, a 600-range dash stun that opens with an auto reset. - Aegis Assault: 22s channel — Condemn cancels it. - Grand Starfall: 180s, 5500 range. - Condemn: 20s. - Final Hour: 100s.

notes: Champion-wide error the mirror also caught and worth acting on beyond this matchup: several vayne strings treat Tumble as an invisibility escape from level 2. Tumble is a roll that empowers the next attack; the stealth only exists while Final Hour is active. This page's phases[4].why ('Final Hour stealth-tumbles') is correct because it is scoped to 6, but the same template line appears on matchups where it is not.
